title: uat.rs: one policy module for where the uat stop sits and which lanes it covers
action:
Create packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/uat.rs and register it in the crate root (lib.rs, or main.rs if that is where modules are declared — check before writing). It holds the whole uat-placement policy, stated once, so the merge side and the close side never carry two copies of it (CONTEXT.md D1, D2).

(1) `pub(crate) enum UatStop { Merge, Close, Off }`, derive Debug/Clone/Copy/PartialEq.

(2) `pub(crate) fn uat_stop_config(main_root: &Path) -> Option<UatStop>` — fail closed, modelled on `uat_before_merge_config` at packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/worktree/phases.rs:683-689. Read order, stated once and only here: if `.bee/config.json` has `uat_stop`, it wins — the strings "merge"/"close"/"off" map to the three variants and ANY other value (wrong string, wrong type) returns None; else if it has `uat_before_merge`, read it as the D1 back-compat alias — Bool(true) => Merge, Bool(false) => Off, any non-boolean => None; else Merge (absent means today's behavior). Read config via `crate::state::read_config_raw(main_root)`.

(3) `pub(crate) fn uat_gate_applies_to_lane(mode: Option<&str>) -> bool` — MOVED here verbatim from phases.rs:698-700, keeping its exact semantics (only tiny/small/docs/spike are exempt; a missing, null, or unrecognized mode fails CLOSED as standard). Delete the copy in phases.rs and have phases.rs call this one — a re-export is fine, a second copy is not.

(4) Unit tests in the same file covering every read-order branch: uat_stop "merge"/"close"/"off"; uat_stop wins over a contradicting uat_before_merge; uat_before_merge true => Merge and false => Off when uat_stop is absent; both keys absent => Merge; a bogus uat_stop string => None; a non-boolean uat_before_merge => None; and the lane rule for tiny/small/docs/spike (exempt) plus standard/high-risk/None/unknown (applies).

Do NOT change any behavior at the merge or close call sites in this cell beyond the phases.rs lane-rule delegation — usp-2 and usp-3 own those. The crate must still compile and the existing suite must still pass.
done_when: packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/uat.rs exists and is registered in the crate; uat_stop_config resolves every documented branch including both fail-closed None cases; uat_gate_applies_to_lane lives ONLY in uat.rs and phases.rs delegates to it with no second copy; the new unit tests pass and the pre-existing suite still passes.
notes: Phase 1, blocks usp-2 and usp-3. Pure policy read, no user-visible behavior of its own — the one justified skeleton exception, made visible by usp-2 in the same slice (plan.md).

truths: uat_stop wins over uat_before_merge whenever it is present.
uat_before_merge true reads as Merge and false reads as Off when uat_stop is absent, so no existing repo changes behavior.
Both keys absent resolves to Merge.
An unrecognized uat_stop value, and a non-boolean uat_before_merge, each return None rather than guessing.
uat_gate_applies_to_lane exists in exactly one place in the crate and keeps its fail-closed-as-standard semantics.
The pre-existing test suite still passes.

report.outcome: Added uat.rs with UatStop enum, uat_stop_config (D1 read order), and uat_gate_applies_to_lane (D2) moved from phases.rs; phases.rs now delegates to it, no second copy.
